articles.title: Trump claims he ended India-Pak conflict, says Pak PM Shehbaz Sharif told him 35 million would have died otherwise
articles.summary: During his State of the Union Address, US President Donald Trump claimed he had ended eight wars, notably including the India-Pakistan conflict. This assertion likely refers to de-escalation following tensions like the Pulwama attack and Balakot airstrikes. Trump's statement underscores the international community's focus on South Asian stability and potential US diplomatic involvement in regional disputes, a key point for SSB aspirants to understand regarding global affairs.

articles.title: U.S. accelerates major military deployment as Iran deadline looms
articles.summary: The U.S. is accelerating a significant military deployment, with a mid-March deadline to position all forces for potential operations against Iran. This marks the most substantial preparation to date, signaling heightened tensions and the possibility of a major international military engagement. SSB aspirants should understand the strategic implications of such large-scale deployments on global security and foreign policy dynamics.

articles.title: Indian Navy to commission 'Dolphin Hunter' INS Anjadip in Chennai
articles.summary: The Indian Navy is set to commission INS Anjadip at Chennai port on February 27, significantly bolstering coastal defence. This vessel is the third of eight indigenously built Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW SWC) series. Its induction enhances the Navy's capabilities in anti-submarine operations and strengthens maritime security, vital for protecting India's strategic interests and ensuring national defence preparedness.
